Abt Heinrich und der Konvent von St. Gallen übertragen dem Kloster Tänikon gegen einen jährlichen Zins das Eigentumsrecht an durch Eberhard von Bichelsee aufgegebenen Besitzungen in Hofstetten und Umgebung.

entries.english:
Abbot Heinrich and the convent of St. Gallen transfer to the convent of Tänikon, in return for an annual rent, ownership of the properties at Hofstetten and nearby places surrendered by Eberhard von Bichelsee.

Heinrich, by God's grace abbot, and the entire convent of the monastery of St. Gallen wish salvation and knowledge of the following to all who see this document. To increase the observance of religion through our acts, the order of our piety and devotion demands and requires it. Let all the faithful of Christ who need to know understand from this document that, purely and simply for God's sake and at the urgent request of our valiant Ritter Eberhard von Bichelsee, steward and ministerial of our monastery, we have duly and lawfully transferred, with full right, by way of gift and public conveyance, the ownership and lordship of all the following properties, which belonged to us and our monastery and which the said Ritter held from us as a fief: the property called the estate at Hofstetten, yielding twenty units; the property at Huzthetal, yielding seven units; those at Lobistal and Rugben; the holding at Buoch; and the property called Stroelis Gut, yielding seven units. We transfer them to the beloved in Christ, Abbess Guota, sister of the aforementioned Ritter, and the convent of the monastery at Tänikon, on behalf of that monastery, to hold for themselves and their successors in perpetuity under an annual rent of two pounds of wax, payable each year on the feast of St. Gall. We intend that ownership of these properties shall henceforth belong to the monastery at Tänikon without any opposition, and promise in good faith never to act against the foregoing in word or deed. In witness of this we have caused our seals to be affixed to this document. Issued at St. Gallen in the year of the Lord 1304, on the tenth day before the Kalends of July, in the presence of Lord C., the Schenk von Landegg; Lord Eglolf von Rosenberg, Ritter; Lutolt, son of the said Schenk; H. called Omin; Volrich called Meldelin; Her. called of Ren; and many other trustworthy people. We, the aforementioned Abbess Guota, on behalf of ourselves and our convent, have caused to be affixed the seal which we and our convent have hitherto customarily used.

Seals: (A) two seals, the first fragmentary (illustration 112), the second missing; (B) seal detached and missing.
